verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a fiat-to-crypto payments/API platform, not an AI agent or agent-host product that consumes external tools via MCP; the evidence only shows MoonPay exposing its own docs as an MCP server for other agents to query (moonpay-docs-6, moonpay-probe-3), which is the opposite role (server, not client). Plugging in external MCP servers so MoonPay 'can use their tools' is a category error for this kind of product.
